info.title: Flood insurance claims by county and year (FEMA NFIP, OpenFEMA), 1978 to 2026: data API
info.summary: Static, read-only JSON and CSV files. No key, no sign-up. CORS open.
info.description:
Flood insurance claims by county and year (FEMA NFIP, OpenFEMA), 1978 to 2026: Every National Flood Insurance Program claim in FEMA's public NFIP claims file, counted for the nation, each state and territory and each county by the year of the loss: claims, claims with a payment and dollars paid (building, contents and increased cost of compliance), over all years since 1978, the ten full years 2016 to 2025, the latest full year and the current, partial year, with the flood event that brought the most claims since 2016 in each state. Counts and sums only; no policy, address or claimant detail is kept.

Probative is a marketing firm, not a law firm; not legal advice. Every JSON response starts with a "meta" object holding the credit line, citation, DOI and license (CC BY 4.0).
